9287f7ca: ;
 .;The purpose of this routine is to determine if the specified
 .;record has exceeded the time limit for its current status.
 .;Initializes variables and retrieves relevant data from the record.
3971cbba: Retrieve related date parameters from TIU record
75b6f265: If a DT sub-field exists, get the date/time stamp from there.
c1dfe959: Get the current date/time for comparisons.
514bf937: Check if the TIU record status matches one of the defined statuses that requires time limit checking.
830eb231: If the status is 'INCOMPLETE', calculate the number of days since it was last updated and set the DGJTFLAG if the time limit has been exceeded.
7fd11e82: If the status is 'DICTATED', set the flag to indicate the time limit has been exceeded.
34ccf893: If the status is 'TRANSCRIBED', compare the current date/time to the allowed time limit and set the flag if it has been exceeded.
f7bc5aff: If the status is 'SIGNED' and there is an allowed time limit specified, compare the current date/time to the time limit and set the flag if it has been exceeded.
86a1b6cf: Exit point if none of the status checks applied.
7729c9c8: Routine to calculate the number of days between two dates.
